Class FlyWheel

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.velocity.SmartVelocityMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.velocity.FlyWheel
yams.commands3.mechanisms.FlyWheel
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandMechanism
public class FlyWheel extends FlyWheel implements CommandMechanism
Command-based extension of FlyWheel that adds the Mechanism binding and Command/Trigger factories.

Usage Example

// Construct using a fully configured FlyWheelConfig
FlyWheel shooter = new FlyWheel(config);

// Spin at a fixed target RPM (runs continuously as a repeated command)
Command spinUp = shooter.run(RPM.of(3000));

// Block until the wheel reaches 3000 RPM within ±50 RPM, then finish
Command spinToSpeed = shooter.runTo(RPM.of(3000), RPM.of(50));

// Trigger that is true whenever the wheel is within ±50 RPM of target
Trigger atSpeed = shooter.near(RPM.of(3000), RPM.of(50));

    • run

      public <T> org.wpilib.command3.Command run(Supplier<T> velocity)
      Run the FlyWheel to a given velocity
      Type Parameters:
      T - Must be a LinearVelocity or AngularVelocity
      Parameters:
      velocity - Supplier of LinearVelocity or AngularVelocity
      Returns:
      Command which runs the FlyWheel to the desired velocity with the closed loop controller.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the value returned by velocity when this method is called is neither an AngularVelocity nor a LinearVelocity.
      FlyWheelConfigurationException - if the value returned by velocity is a LinearVelocity and the FlyWheel diameter is not configured.
